title: Recipe
description: Structured representation of a single recipe extracted from a web source. Mirrors the content of recipes/<Name>/README.md in machine-readable form.

title.description: Display title of the recipe in the source's casing (not the kebab-case directory name).

source.description: Author and/or publication, e.g. 'Smitten Kitchen (Deb Perelman)' or 'Beth Moncel, Budget Bytes'.

url.description: Canonical URL of the original recipe page.

prep.description: Prep time as the source presents it (e.g., '15 minutes'); null if not provided.

cook.description: Cook time as the source presents it (e.g., '55–65 minutes'); null if not provided.

servings.description: Servings as the source presents it (e.g., '4–6', '8 to 10'); null if not provided.

ingredients.description: Ingredient list grouped by section. Most recipes have a single group with a null name; multi-section recipes use named groups like 'For Serving'.

name.description: Section name (e.g., 'For Serving'); null for the default/main group.

items.description: Ingredient lines kept verbatim from the source — measurements, units, descriptors, and prep notes ('chopped', 'divided') all preserved.

instructions.description: Numbered steps in order. Each step has a short bolded lead phrase plus a paraphrased detail body.

lead.description: Short lead phrase, e.g. 'Brown the chicken.' (rendered bold in the README).

detail.description: Paraphrased step body with all technical details preserved (temperatures, times, quantities, equipment, order of operations).

nutrition.description: Per-serving nutrition. Each field is the source's value as a string (preserving units, e.g. '295 cal', '10.88g'), or null if the source does not provide that field.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes (e.g., toddler portioning, substitutions). Null when no notes are present.
